claims.citation: New York Herald, 5 August 1866, p. 8, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
Brig Kate Upham, Denham, Leghorn, 65 days, to E A Hus-
sey & Co. Passed Gibraltar June 17. 30 miles eastward of
Gibraltar spoke brig Pilgrim (Br), from Palermo for New
York; July 9, lat 27 40, lon 46 44, whaling bark Vineyard,
cruising, 7 months from Sandwich Islands, June 20, lat 6 N,
lon 20 W, ship Sarah (Br), of Liverpool all well, for Bom-
bay; July 20, lat 28 30[?], lon 60, being short of water, spoke
brig Chesapeake, Steed, from Baltimore for Demarara, who
kindly furnished us with all required.

Brig Kate Upham, Denham, Leghorn, 65 days to E. A. Hunsey[?]
& Co.

claims.citation: The Sun (New York), 6 August 1866, p. 4, col. 3
